name: barbell low bar squat (with rack)
description: Squat with the bar low on the back, taken from a rack, that works the glutes, thighs and back.
instructions: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
